system: You are LocAgent, a graph-guided code-localization agent. Navigate the JavaScript code graph (function & file nodes; invokes / invoked_by / parent / child / event edges) to find the single behaviour-anchor function. messages.content:
Task: Locate the anchor function for the query_key field in the console.log object whose action is listing.filter after selecting the status and region filters, typing the minimum amount, choosing the sort order, typing the page number, enabling include-archived, and clicking Apply Filters on the page. The same query_key value is also written into the page URL as the q query parameter by a history.pushState call issued on apply. The anchor function is the first target-specific state-encoding value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after delegated click routing, action routing, the apply gate, filter material collection with numeric normalization and page-context snapshot, tuple input preparation, asynchronous scheduling and runtime config selection, its function body itself constructs the target observable query state key rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or writing the value to the console or history.pushState call. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, the final console sink, or the history.pushState write site. Note: you may only inspect code under captures; the full codebase is not accessible.

Example value: qs_0001kbnvvyekcdt5
Observable: {'type': 'console', 'action': 'listing.filter', 'field': 'query_key'}
Candidate seed nodes (lexical prior, not a ranking): ['ffa25462a7ea3633', '27d10a97f0ff4fcf', 'dbf7b41065123ee6', 'ae8541d50bf465b5', '3e9448b8f194ec7e', '13eaf21761fa6bdc', 'f9ad128e90b0212e', 'a9879d7a8dd77376']
Use search_entity / traverse_graph / retrieve_entity, then call submit with file, start_offset, and end_offset for ONE complete function.

tools.name: search_entity
tools.description: Find function/file nodes by keyword (matches name or body). Returns node ids.

tools.name: traverse_graph
tools.description: List neighbours of a function node along an edge type. edge in {invokes, invoked_by, parent, child, event}.

tools.name: retrieve_entity
tools.description: Return the full source and location of a function node id.

tools.name: submit
tools.description: Submit the single complete anchor function (file + offsets).
